title: My car radio read out my route 📻
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 12:20 at night my car radio started reading out my route.

scenes.narration: At 12:20 at night my car radio started reading out my route.
I had not touched it. A calm voice said, Turning left in two hundred metres. I was not planning to turn left.
Then, Straight on. Then, You will pass the old garage. It said it gently, almost fondly. I passed the old garage.
It knew every turn before I made it. Not like a sat nav. Like someone who had already watched me drive it, night after night.
I tried to switch it off. The dial spun and spun. The voice said, Please do not pull over. Pulling over takes longer.
I took the next left, because it told me to. A long road with no lights, and at the end of it, my own house. My own window, lit.
You have arrived, said the voice. And then, softer, as the engine died. Thank you for bringing me home. I have been waiting in this car for a very long time.
So tell me. Do you go inside, or drive away?
